SELECT a.bbs_id, /* 게시판ID */ b.pst_id, /* 게시물ID */ b.bbs_type_cd AS category_cd, /* 분류코드 */ (SELECT s.cmmn_cd_nm FROM cdm_own.cmmn_cd s WHERE s.cd_grop_cd = 'FAQ_CLSF_CD' AND s.cmmn_cd = b.bbs_type_cd AND s.lcal_cd = 'ko') AS category_nm, /* 분류명 */ b.ttl AS question, /* 질문 */ b.ntc_yn AS display_yn, /* 노출여부 */ (SELECT s.cmmn_cd_nm FROM cdm_own.cmmn_cd s WHERE s.cd_grop_cd = 'YN_CD' AND s.cmmn_cd = b.ntc_yn AND s.lcal_cd = 'ko') AS display_yn_nm, /* 노출여부명 */ TO_CHAR(b.reg_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS reg_dt, /* 등록일 */ b.rgtr_id, /* 등록자ID */ (SELECT s.usr_nm FROM cdm_own.usr s WHERE s.usr_id = b.rgtr_id) AS rgtr_id_nm, /* 등록자명 */ COALESCE(b.inq_cnt, 0) AS viewCount /* 조회수 */ FROM cdm_own.cmpt_bbs a /* 게시판 */ INNER JOIN cdm_own.cmpt_bbs_pst b /* 게시물 */ ON a.bbs_id = b.bbs_id WHERE 1=1 AND a.bbs_id = 'FAQ'
AND b.bbs_type_cd = #{categoryCd}
AND b.ntc_yn = #{displayYn}
AND b.reg_dt >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND b.reg_dt <= TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + INTERVAL '1 day' - INTERVAL '1 second'
AND (b.ttl LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%' OR b.pst_cn LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%')
ORDER BY b.reg_dt DESC

SELECT a.bbs_id, /* 게시판ID */ b.pst_id, /* 게시물ID */ b.bbs_type_cd AS category_cd, /* 분류코드 */ (SELECT s.cmmn_cd_nm FROM cdm_own.cmmn_cd s WHERE s.cd_grop_cd = 'FAQ_CLSF_CD' AND s.cmmn_cd = b.bbs_type_cd AND s.lcal_cd = 'ko') AS category_nm, /* 분류명 */ b.ttl AS question, /* 질문 */ b.pst_cn AS answer, /* 답변 */ b.ntc_yn AS display_yn, /* 노출여부 */ 0 AS sort_order, /* 정렬순서 */ TO_CHAR(b.reg_dt, 'YYYY.MM.DD HH24:MI:SS') AS reg_dt, /* 등록일 */ b.rgtr_id, /* 등록자ID */ TO_CHAR(b.mdfcn_dt, 'YYYY.MM.DD HH24:MI:SS') AS upd_dt, /* 수정일 */ b.mdfr_id /* 수정자ID */ FROM cdm_own.cmpt_bbs a /* 게시판 */ INNER JOIN cdm_own.cmpt_bbs_pst b /* 게시물 */ ON a.bbs_id = b.bbs_id WHERE 1=1 AND b.pst_id = #{pstId}
SELECT cd, cd_nm AS cdNm FROM cdm_own.cmpt_cmpy_cd WHERE cd_group = 'FAQ_CLSF_CD' order by sort_sn
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cdm_own.cmpt_bbs_pst ( bbs_id, pst_id, bbs_type_cd, ttl, pst_cn, ntc_yn, inq_cnt, reg_dt, rgtr_id ) VALUES ( #{bbsId}, 'FAQ_' || TO_CHAR(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISSMS'), #{categoryCd}, #{question}, #{answer}, #{displayYn}, 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{rgtrId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE cdm_own.cmpt_bbs_pst SET bbs_type_cd = #{categoryCd}, ttl = #{question}, pst_cn = #{answer}, ntc_yn = #{displayYn}, mdfcn_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, mdfr_id = #{mdfrId} WHERE pst_id = #{pstId}
